info.name: RideLink Ride Management API
info.description:
Comprehensive positive and negative test suite for Ride Management Service (Member 3) running on port 8083.

Pre-requisite: Obtain a valid JWT token from Account Service (POST http://localhost:8081/api/v1/auth/login) and set it in the collection variable 'jwt_token'.
